meta.philosophy: Detrained body in a calorie deficit on a GLP-1 drug: the job is holding onto muscle while the scale drops, not chasing numbers. Three full-body sessions, any order, any three days, each one hits everything so a missed or reordered day never breaks the program. Machines and cables over free weights because he trains alone and needs to walk up to a labeled machine and know exactly what to do with it.

rampIn.rule: Weeks 1 and 2 use rampSets instead of the listed sets (usually 2 instead of 3) and RPE stays at 5-6, meaning stop with 4-5 reps left in the tank, not 2-3. Same exercises, same order, just less volume and no grinding reps, so soreness stays mild enough that he actually shows up for session 2 and 3.

exercises.name: Chest Press
exercises.where: Pin-loaded machine line, mid floor
exercises.cue: Set the seat so the handles line up mid-chest before picking a weight, not after.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.where: Leg section of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width on the plate, stop the knees short of locking out at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.where: Next to the pulldown machine in the selectorized section
exercises.cue: Chest stays pinned to the pad the whole set, pull with the shoulder blades not the arms.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.where: Upper body end of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Handles start at shoulder height, press straight up without banging the elbows into lockout.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.where: Leg section, usually beside leg extension
exercises.cue: Pad sits just above the heel, don't let the lower back arch off the seat to cheat the rep.

exercises.name: Triceps Press
exercises.where: Upper body end of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Keep the elbows tucked to the sides, only the forearm should move.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.where: Dual-tower cable station, central strength zone
exercises.cue: Kneel below the pulley, curl the ribs toward the hips, don't just pull with the arms.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.where: Pin-loaded machine line, beside the seated row
exercises.cue: Lock the thigh pads down first, pull the bar to the upper chest, don't lean back to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.where: Plate-loaded leg zone
exercises.cue: Load both sides evenly and control the negative, this one moves independently per leg.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press
exercises.where: Cable/functional-trainer wall, dual-adjustable-pulley station
exercises.cue: Set both pulleys at chest height and press forward without letting the shoulders round.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.where: Leg section, next to leg curl
exercises.cue: Pad rests on the shins above the ankle, back stays flat against the pad, no jerking the weight up.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.where: Dual-tower cable station, central strength zone
exercises.cue: Set the pulley at face height, pull the rope apart toward the ears, elbows stay high.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.where: Free-weight floor, mirrored wall section
exercises.cue: Pick a weight you can control for all reps without swinging the torso.

exercises.name: Triceps Press
exercises.where: Upper body end of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Elbows tucked, full extension at the bottom without locking hard.

exercises.name: Chest Press
exercises.where: Plate-loaded strength zone, near the free weights
exercises.cue: Load plates evenly on both sides and press each arm together, don't let one side lead.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.where: Plate-loaded zone, chest-supported row unit
exercises.cue: Chest stays against the pad, pull each handle back independently and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.where: Leg section of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width on the plate, knees track over the toes, don't lock out.

exercises.name: Smith Shoulder Press
exercises.where: Fixed vertical bar track along the free-weight wall
exercises.cue: Set the safety hooks below your lowest rep depth before loading the bar.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.where: Leg section, usually beside leg extension
exercises.cue: Pad just above the heel, keep the lower back flat instead of arching to move the weight.

exercises.name: Cable Pulldown
exercises.where: Dual-tower cable station, central strength zone
exercises.cue: Set the pulley overhead, kneel or sit, pull to the upper chest without leaning back.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.where: Dual-tower cable station, central strength zone
exercises.cue: Rotate hips and ribs together, keep the arms fairly straight, and don't yank with the shoulders.
